properties.description: inference.rs: a TemporalFact premise holds when measured (or unstated, read as measured) and still standing — nothing INVALIDATES it, it states no end (valid_to, or a VALID_TO epoch), no accepted decision discontinues it; a forecast, ended or invalidated one is unknown. A ChangeEvent is history: an objection never makes it read false, so a counter-argument is recorded as a statement of its own (a Requirement with statement_kind) that CONTRADICTS the claim and is answered there. An accepted Decision a step concludes holds on its owner's acceptance, with the chain's own verdict read beside it (chain_reading; reasoning_report `acceptance` and `chain`; the change walk's `accepted_without_a_holding_chain`; conclusion_does_not_follow still asks about the chain), and its read-back `says` its `chose`. capture-intent, brainstorm and the served instructions agree a Decision may be a chain's conclusion when its premises are checkable.
properties.name: A measured finding holds as a premise, history never reads false, and an accepted Decision reads its acceptance beside its chain
